ITEM 1 | Long thin green beans, bright green with darker edges, slightly glossy, arranged in a loose pile on the left side of the plate, each about 6-8 cm long and roughly 0.5 cm thick; they hold their shape, no visible breading or char | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale golden-tan grain mixture, small granular kernels with a crumbly, fluffy texture, mounded in the upper right of the plate about 7 cm across and 2-3 cm high, with scattered loose grains around its edge | 110
ITEM 3 | Single whole small red tomato half-sized piece with glossy red skin and slightly wrinkled surface, sitting on top of the grain mound near its center, about 2.5 cm across | 15
ITEM 4 | Sliced cooked meat with browned, slightly charred outer edges and pinkish-brown interior, moist and juicy looking with a light sheen, cut into overlapping slices about 1 cm thick, lying across the right side of the plate next to the grain mound, roughly 9 cm long and 5 cm wide | 130
ITEM 5 | Rectangular baked flatbread-style pieces topped with melted pale cheese and red-orange tomato sauce, with browned spots and dark char marks on the cheese, two pieces about 7 x 5 cm and 6 x 4 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the bottom center-right of the plate, crisp-looking edges | 120
